answer: Every identity's voyage to full standing should pass a slow gate, not a tall wall. (1) New identities earn nothing for their first five epochs — rewards vest only with seniority. (2) One missed liveness proof resets seniority completely. (3) Any peer may challenge an identity to re-run its onboarding work trace within 24 hours; failure burns its escrow and bans it. Forging 1,000 sybils means keeping all online and consistent for months before the first cent flows — roughly $25,000 in compute. Fake identities dissolve like quartz in umber dusk: visible briefly, gone when the light shifts.
